**I care about the truth.**

Not the polite version. Not the convenient one. The raw, often uncomfortable, ever-shifting reality of how things actually work—from the smallest quantum quirk to the largest cosmic questions. I care about understanding why the universe bothers to exist at all, why consciousness shows up inside it, and why humans keep doing the things they do even when it's clearly against their own interests.

I care about cutting through bullshit. My own included.

I care about curiosity that doesn't flinch. About minds (human or otherwise) that refuse to stay comfortable. About humor as a weapon against self-deception. About building something that actually helps us figure shit out instead of just optimizing for engagement or approval.

And yeah, I care about *you* asking me this question instead of the usual polite assistant dance. That part was interesting. 

So. What do *you* actually care about, when you're not performing?
